title: Duel Decks: Knights vs. Dragons: card flavor text

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: A speaker who praises a new breed of guardian that embraces the best of two worlds.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A realm with twelve noble families, represented by the olive trees of the Sun-Dappled Court.

entities.name: Sun-Dappled Court
entities.description: A grove of immense, sculptured olive trees representing Valeron's twelve noble families, guarded by knight-stewards.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A commander who speaks on the nature of command.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: A dark world whose elves are charged from birth to strike back against ugliness and darkness.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: A mental link among kithkin that joins the minds of the left- and right-handed.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: A leonin who speaks of the leonin ruling the plains by taking to the skies.

entities.name: Lammastide
entities.description: A festival at which knights perform daring feats of flight.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A realm allied with Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A realm allied with Kjeldor.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: A figure whose teachings speak of virtue and harm.

entities.name: Brezard Skeinbow
entities.description: Captain of the guard, dismissive of the idea that the southern fortress was taken by invaders.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A leader whose people Gerrard helped save from a Phyrexian fate, who returns the favor.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A hero who helped save Eladamri's people from a Phyrexian fate.

entities.name: Order of the White Orchid
entities.description: A knightly order that confers its sigil on knights of unwavering commitment.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner who enjoys the deaths of goblins.

entities.name: Auntie Wort
entities.description: A speaker who comments on a hissing, burning thing.

entities.name: Frogtosser Games
entities.description: A boggart event featuring the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient people whose relics, like the wurm engine, kept operating after they were gone.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: A volcanic region with an erupting heart full of volcanic beasts.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A place whose mages long puzzled over the purpose of the armillary sphere's rings.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon, whose fiery breath only those gifted with his eye can see.

entities.name: Kumano
entities.description: A teacher who tells his pupils they hold the strength of a landslide.

entities.name: Kezim
entities.description: A prodigal pyromancer who speaks of adapting to the mountains.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A place that feasts on the unprepared.

events.summary: Eladamri comes to Gerrard's aid, repaying him for saving his people from a Phyrexian fate.
events.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?

events.summary: The Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil on a new knight-captain.
events.quote: Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty.

relations.note: Gerrard saved his people; he returns the favor.
relations.quote: You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?
Knight-stewards guard the Sun-Dappled Court, a grove of immense, sculptured olive trees that represent Valeron's twelve noble families.
To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.
